{{- $date := . -}} {{- $day := $date.Day -}} {{- $month := $date.Month -}} {{- $year := $date.Year -}} {{- $monthName := "" -}} {{- if eq $month 1 }}{{ $monthName = "januari" }}{{ end -}} {{- if eq $month 2 }}{{ $monthName = "februari" }}{{ end -}} {{- if eq $month 3 }}{{ $monthName = "maart" }}{{ end -}} {{- if eq $month 4 }}{{ $monthName = "april" }}{{ end -}} {{- if eq $month 5 }}{{ $monthName = "mei" }}{{ end -}} {{- if eq $month 6 }}{{ $monthName = "juni" }}{{ end -}} {{- if eq $month 7 }}{{ $monthName = "juli" }}{{ end -}} {{- if eq $month 8 }}{{ $monthName = "augustus" }}{{ end -}} {{- if eq $month 9 }}{{ $monthName = "september" }}{{ end -}} {{- if eq $month 10 }}{{ $monthName = "oktober" }}{{ end -}} {{- if eq $month 11 }}{{ $monthName = "november" }}{{ end -}} {{- if eq $month 12 }}{{ $monthName = "december" }}{{ end -}} {{- printf "%d %s %d" $day $monthName $year -}}
